_note: Manual resolutions for errata whose CRD 'Original Text' does not match the printing word for word. Each is derived only from the CRD's own updated wording; see 'reason'. Key = card_id|first CRD number.

OP1_OP_P8|P8.reason: CRD says the OP1 images are the MRP. The printed parenthetical is the same updated text with the clauses in a slightly different order ('Once per combat you may place ... as an action').

edits: [Instant]: When entering combat, you may discard
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. You may discard
S01_BST_114|U114.reason: Printing already shows the lightning (Instant) icon but not the 'POWER: Use when' wording; CRD updated text applied to that span. The printed '(Limit 1 per deck.)' line is kept.

S01_BST_126|R126.text: POWER: Name a Physical Combat, Energy Combat, or Event card. Search your opponent's Life Deck for all copies of that card and banishes them. (Banish after use.)
S01_BST_126|R126.reason: Printed text is garbled ('opponent's his', no comma); the whole card text is replaced by the CRD updated text (CRD's own 'banishes' wording kept).

S01_PRO_P16|R126.text: POWER: Name a Physical Combat, Energy Combat, or Event card. Search your opponent's Life Deck for all copies of that card and banishes them. (Banish after use.)

S01_BST_139|R139.reason: CRD (Panini) adds 'Styled'; FanZ adds '(Limit 1 per deck.)'. Printed order of the sentences differs from the CRD's, so the two changes are applied to the printed text.

edits: Search your Life Deck for a non-Dragon Ball card
[Trait:God]: Search your Life Deck for a non-Dragon Ball card
S01_PRO_P18|R129.reason: CRD adds the God Trait condition; printing says 'place it in your hand' (typo) so the CRD original does not match word for word.

S03_PRO_P9|P9.reason: CRD adds the attack icon and the serial comma.

S08_BST_02|R2.reason: Printing already has 'a Styled card'; CRD updated text also changes 'from' to 'with'.

S13_BST_07|DR7.reason: CRD says the Fusion images are the MRP; the printed sentence is the same updated rule reworded ('Shuffle up to 3 cards with ... text-box or parenthetical text from your discard pile').

S16_BST_19|DR19.reason: CRD says the Premier: Dragon Ball Super images are the MRP; the printed text is the updated rule (cost -1 stage, cannot lower a cost to 0) in FanZ wording.
